summary: Full end-to-end test of new 'DR AI ile Üret' feature. Backend (6/6 pytest tests pass incl. gpt-image-2 mockup) and frontend (idea -> 4 questions -> blueprint -> skip mockup -> lead -> success) + admin panel (DR AI Talepleri tab shows lead, view modal shows idea/Q&A/blueprint). All review requirements pass.

backend.POST /api/dr-ai/blueprint: 200, returns blueprint with non-empty modules, project_name, project_type, target_users, admin_features, platform, optional_features, next_step
backend.DELETE /api/admin/ai-leads/{id}: 200, resource removed and verified via GET
backend.POST /api/dr-ai/mockup: 200 in ~60s, returns 2 /api/uploads/*.png URLs, both fetch HTTP 200

frontend.navbar order: Ana Sayfa | Hizmetler | DR AI ile Üret | Projeler | Hakkımızda | Blog | İletişim - correct
frontend.blueprint stage reached: showed project_name (BayiPulse Portal), modules, target users
frontend.lead validation (empty name+phone): toast 'Ad Soyad ve Telefon zorunludur.' shown, no success advance
frontend.lead submit success screen: dr-ai-success shown, 'Powered by Dijital Roket AI' visible, success steps rendered
frontend.admin login + DR AI Talepleri tab: container admin-ai-leads visible; QA Test Lead FE row shown with BayiPulse Portal
frontend.view modal: shows İlk Fikir (idea), Soru & Cevaplar (Q&A), Project Blueprint with modules

verification_results.mockup_path_note: Not exercised via UI (skipped per spec, slow ~60-90s). Verified via backend pytest instead which loads both images successfully.

critical_code_review_comments: DrAiUret.jsx is 588 lines - within limit but nearing the 700-line threshold; consider splitting stage components (QuestionsPanel/BlueprintPanel/LeadForm) if further growth is planned.
admin_ai_leads returns raw mongo docs with '_id' (string uuid, JSON-safe). Frontend maps _id -> id which is fine, but for API contract consistency consider serializing to 'id' server-side.

dr_ai_mockup runs two image generations concurrently with asyncio.gather; if one succeeds and one fails, only the successful URL is returned (no partial-error signalling). Acceptable, but consider surfacing a warning.
The 'DR AI · YAPAY ZEKA ÜRETİM SİSTEMİ' hero on /dr-ai-ile-uret has no h1 (page uses styled div). Minor SEO gap but SEO component sets title/description so acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted test lead 'QA Test Lead FE' (id c161c4422b7a444eae976b82fd0c48fe) after admin flow verification. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_dr_ai.py covers the DR AI feature end-to-end incl. slow gpt-image-2 mockup. Skip mockup with `--deselect` if quick smoke run needed. Frontend flow uses test-ids dr-ai-input/submit/answer-input/option-<qi>-<oi>/answer-submit/blueprint/mockup-yes/mockup-no/dr-ai-mockups/dr-ai-mockup-img-<i>/dr-ai-mockup-feedback-<k>/lead-name/company/phone/email/note/lead-submit/dr-ai-success. Admin tab in sidebar: click text 'DR AI Talepleri'; container has data-testid='admin-ai-leads'; view button data-testid='ai-lead-view-<id>'. Note: [data-testid='dr-ai-blueprint'] is present continuously in the right column from questions stage onward — do NOT use it as a stage-transition indicator; use [data-testid='dr-ai-mockup-yes'] to detect blueprint stage instead.
